{{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS084 |prevtitle=Clefabulous Clefable |nextcode=PS086 |nexttitle=Double Dragonair |series=Yellow |colorscheme=Yellow}} {{ChapInfobox |title_en=Gimme Shellder |title_ja=VSシェルダー |title_ro=VS Shellder |image=PS085.png |scheme=Yellow |pub1=Shogakukan full volume |pub1-data=Chapter 85 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|7}} |pub2=VIZ Media monthly issue |pub2-data=Chapter 45 in [[Bruno's Battle]] |pub3=VIZ Media full volume |pub3-data=Adventure 85 in {{vol|Pokémon Adventures|7}} |location=[[Cerise Island]] }} '''Gimme Shellder''' (Japanese: '''VSシェルダー''' ''VS Shellder'') is the 85th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 45th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Yellow}}. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} {{adv|Red}} watches [[Bruno]] disappear into the tunnels. [[Lt. Surge]] throws {{adv|Bill}} from the electrical pod, and Bill shouts at him. Lt. Surge says that the team earlier was for the sake of beating the [[Elite Four]], and he will join [[Koga]] and [[Sabrina]]. Bill says that [[Team Rocket]] should never be trusted, and puts on an annoyed look as Lt. Surge goes away on his {{p|Magneton}}. Afterwards, Bill notices an opening made by {{p|Jolteon}}'s {{m|Pin Missile}} on the side of the cave, and sees that the rocky wall is actually a mirror-like glass structure. He remembers hearing stirs from that side of the room earlier, and motions Red to go with him and check it out. Meanwhile, {{adv|Blue}} continues to struggle against [[Agatha's Gengar]]. He eventually deduces that without Agatha to give Gengar orders, Gengar is attacking them from the shadows and makes its move whenever it detects sound. Some distance away, [[Koga]] manages to silently send Blue a message via {{p|Koffing}}'s smoke; Blue understands the plan and makes his move. Gengar emerges from the shadows to attack, only to hit the discarded tail from Koga's {{p|Arbok}}. Blue takes this chance and knocks Gengar out with his {{TP|Blue|Porygon}}'s {{m|Psybeam}}, then has [[Koga's Golbat]] use {{m|Confuse Ray}} to light up the cave, forcing Agatha out from the shadows. Agatha compliments Blue on seeing through her attacks, and Blue chastises her for having criticized him defending Koga's Golbat earlier; the same Golbat now preventing her escape. Agatha remarks on Blue's similarity with {{adv|Professor Oak}}, though she still insists that the [[Pokédex]] was a waste of his talents. She snidely points out, however, that the Confuse Ray blocked everyone's view of [[Misty]]'s message in the sky: a warning that the Elite Four were gathering Badges to make use of their energy for their plans. Agatha proceeds to explain that through her research, she discovered ways to manipulate Pokémon via simple mind-control: she could control entire armies of Pokémon and assign them simple orders, having mobilized them to attack cities in Kanto and look for one Badge that the Elite Four had yet to obtain to complete their plans. She also reveals that special collars latched on her Pokémon give her greater control over them; Bruno wears the same collars on his wrists and had been coerced into the Elite Four's plans without him knowing. Without any Pokémon on hand, Agatha escapes in a swirl of fog as the chamber starts to collapse; Koga makes his own escape with the help of his {{p|Muk}} while Blue goes off in search of {{adv|Red}}, sensing his presence via his Pokédex. ==Major events== * {{adv|Red}} is broken out of the ice by {{adv|Giovanni}} and is given a [[Spoons of Destiny|Spoon of Destiny]]. * Red gets his [[Pokédex]] back. * {{adv|Blue}} is trying to fight [[Agatha]] and her {{TP|Agatha|Gengar}}. * It is revealed that Bruno was mind-controlled by the rest of the [[Elite Four]]. * Agatha reveals some of the plan of the Elite Four. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Red}} * {{adv|Blue}} * {{adv|Yellow}} * {{adv|Professor Oak}} * {{adv|Giovanni}} * {{adv|Bill}} * {{adv|Blaine}} * [[Misty]] * [[Lt.
